title: Benzoin
html_source:
Benzoin is used on minor skin sores and wounds to protect the area from irritation and infection, also used on canker sores in and around the mouth to protect them so they can heal.
Benzoin is also used to help relieve and soothe minor irritation of the nose, throat, and airways (e.g., laryngitis, croup) when it is mixed with hot water and the steam is inhaled.
